fields.name: Shopify Connector: Layer 2 Stale Owner Sweep
Shopify Connector: product media export READY poll

arguments: UNIQUE(lease_key)
A call lease with this key already exists.
constraints.name: _lease_key_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(company_id, scope_key, command_id)
A named connector command may be recorded only once per scope.
constraints.name: _command_scope_uniq

arguments: (mutation_attempt_id) WHERE mutation_attempt_id IS NOT NULL
Only one reconciliation job may own a mutation attempt.
constraints.name: _mutation_attempt_reconciliation_unique

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, idempotency_key)
A job with this idempotency key already exists for this store.
constraints.name: _store_idempotency_key_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, operation_scope_key)
A non-terminal job already holds this operation scope for this store.
constraints.name: _store_operation_scope_key_uniq

arguments: CHECK(attempt_no > 0)
Attempt numbers must be positive.
constraints.name: _attempt_no_positive

arguments: CHECK((requested_cost IS NULL OR requested_cost >= 0) AND (actual_cost IS NULL OR actual_cost >= 0) AND (budget_available IS NULL OR budget_available >= 0) AND (throttle_delay_ms IS NULL OR throttle_delay_ms >= 0))
Cost and throttle observations cannot be negative.
constraints.name: _costs_non_negative

arguments: UNIQUE(job_id, attempt_no)
An attempt number may occur only once for a job.
constraints.name: _job_attempt_no_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(job_id, claim_token)
A claim token may occur only once for a job.
constraints.name: _job_claim_token_uniq

arguments: CHECK((outcome IN ('claimed', 'running') AND finished_at IS NULL) OR (outcome NOT IN ('claimed', 'running') AND finished_at IS NOT NULL))
A completed attempt outcome requires finished_at.
constraints.name: _terminal_finished

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, shopify_location_gid)
A location with this Shopify location GID already exists for this store.
constraints.name: _store_location_gid_uniq

arguments: (job_id, attempt_token)
The attempt token must be unique for this job.
constraints.name: _attempt_token_unique

arguments: CHECK(inconclusive_reconciliation_count >= 0)
The inconclusive reconciliation count cannot be negative.
constraints.name: _non_negative_reconciliation_count

arguments: (job_id)
A mutation job may own only one attempt for its entire lifetime.
constraints.name: _one_attempt_per_job

arguments: CHECK(expected_configuration_generation >= 0)
The expected configuration generation cannot be negative.
constraints.name: _non_negative_configuration_generation

arguments: CHECK(expected_connection_generation >= 0 AND expected_configuration_generation >= 0)
Expected connection/configuration generations cannot be negative.
constraints.name: _generation_non_negative

arguments: The run reference must use the RUN-YYYYMMDD-sequence format.
constraints.name: _name_format

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, request_key)
A run with this request key already exists for this store.
constraints.name: _store_request_key_uniq

arguments: CHECK((state IN ('succeeded', 'partially_succeeded', 'failed_terminal', 'cancelled') AND finished_at IS NOT NULL) OR (state NOT IN ('succeeded', 'partially_succeeded', 'failed_terminal', 'cancelled') AND finished_at IS NULL))
Only terminal runs may have a finished timestamp.
constraints.name: _terminal_finished

arguments: UNIQUE(shop_domain)
A store already exists for this Shopify shop domain.
constraints.name: _shop_domain_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id)
Only one cached access token is allowed per store.
constraints.name: _store_id_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id)
Only one credential record is allowed per store.
constraints.name: _store_id_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id)
Only one settings record is allowed per store.
constraints.name: _store_id_uniq

arguments: CHECK(configuration_generation >= 0)
The connector configuration generation cannot be negative.
constraints.name: _configuration_generation_non_negative

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, shopify_gid)
A fulfillment binding with this Shopify Fulfillment GID already exists for this store.
constraints.name: _store_fulfillment_gid_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, picking_id)
This picking already has a fulfillment binding for this store.
constraints.name: _store_picking_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, shopify_fulfillment_gid)
Inbound evidence for this Shopify Fulfillment GID already exists for this store.
constraints.name: _store_fulfillment_gid_uniq

arguments: CHECK(quantity >= 0 AND reconciled_quantity >= 0)
Fulfillment evidence quantities cannot be negative.
constraints.name: _non_negative_quantity

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, shopify_inventory_item_gid, location_mapping_id)
An inventory-level binding for this Shopify inventory item and mapped location already exists for this store.
constraints.name: _store_inventory_item_location_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, product_variant_binding_id, location_mapping_id)
An inventory-level binding for this product-variant binding and mapped location already exists for this store.
constraints.name: _store_variant_location_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, odoo_location_id)
This Odoo location is already mapped for this store.
constraints.name: _store_odoo_location_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, shopify_gid)
A location mapping with this Shopify Location GID already exists for this store.
constraints.name: _store_shopify_gid_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(job_id)
One inventory observation evidence row is allowed per job.
constraints.name: _job_unique

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, decision_key)
This product match ambiguity is already recorded for the store.
constraints.name: _store_decision_key_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, product_template_id)
This product.template is already bound for this store.
constraints.name: _store_product_template_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, shopify_gid)
A product-template binding with this Shopify GID already exists for this store.
constraints.name: _store_shopify_gid_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, shopify_inventory_item_gid)
This Shopify InventoryItem is already bound to a variant for this store.
constraints.name: _store_inventory_item_gid_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, product_variant_id)
This product.product is already bound for this store.
constraints.name: _store_product_variant_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, shopify_gid)
A product-variant binding with this Shopify GID already exists for this store.
constraints.name: _store_shopify_gid_uniq

arguments: (store_id, product_template_id, state)
constraints.name: _store_template_state_idx

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, shopify_gid)
A product-media binding with this Shopify File GID already exists for this store.
constraints.name: _store_shopify_gid_uniq

arguments: (store_id, product_template_binding_id, media_role, odoo_image_checksum) WHERE product_variant_binding_id IS NULL
This template image checksum is already exported for this store.
constraints.name: _store_template_role_checksum_uniq

arguments: (store_id, product_variant_binding_id, media_role, odoo_image_checksum) WHERE product_variant_binding_id IS NOT NULL
This variant image checksum is already exported for this store.
constraints.name: _store_variant_role_checksum_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, partner_id)
This res.partner is already bound for this store.
constraints.name: _store_partner_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, shopify_gid)
A customer binding with this Shopify GID already exists for this store.
constraints.name: _store_shopify_gid_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, sale_order_id)
This sale order is already bound for this Shopify store.
constraints.name: _store_sale_order_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, shopify_gid)
An order binding with this Shopify GID already exists for this store.
constraints.name: _store_shopify_gid_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, shopify_tax_evidence_key)
This Shopify tax fingerprint is already mapped for the store.
constraints.name: _store_evidence_key_uniq

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, delivery_id)
A Shopify webhook delivery may be recorded only once per store.
constraints.name: _store_delivery_unique

arguments: UNIQUE(token_digest)
Webhook callback tokens must be unique.
constraints.name: _digest_unique

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id)
A Shopify store may have only one active webhook callback token.
constraints.name: _store_unique

arguments: (store_id, shopify_subscription_gid) WHERE shopify_subscription_gid IS NOT NULL
A Shopify subscription GID may belong to only one topic per store.
constraints.name: _store_gid_unique

arguments: UNIQUE(store_id, topic)
A webhook topic may be expected only once per Shopify store.
constraints.name: _store_topic_unique
